source.title: Canonical Orders and Schnyder Realizers
source.subsection: Canonical Order; Definition 1 and Theorem 1 proof
source.reuse: algorithm description only; clean-room bounded profile

input.rotation_system: Simple connected maximal plane triangulation; each row lists distinct neighbors in clockwise order; face walk takes the next clockwise neighbor after the incoming edge.
input.outer_face: The directed face walk u->v->w->u is the selected outer face.

contract.canonical_order: Starts u,v and ends w. Fix w as the first reverse-shelling deletion. On each current u-to-v boundary path, if there are no chords delete the lowest-ID interior boundary vertex; otherwise consider interiors of all inclusion-minimal chords and delete the lowest-ID eligible vertex.
contract.minimal_chord: A boundary chord (i,j) is inclusion-minimal when no other chord (a,b) satisfies i<=a<b<=j with a different endpoint pair; the base edge (0,m-1) is excluded.
contract.complexity: O(n^5) repeated bounded face/chord scans for n<=8; O(n^2) fixed workspace. The chapter's chord-incidence counters reduce its construction to linear time.
contract.profile_scope: Consumes an existing embedding and outputs only the canonical order; embedding construction and drawing are excluded.
